name: Crystal Quest: Frostlands
review:
Gemma heads into icy mountains, on six reels with 4,096 ways. Infinite multipliers, massive symbols, wild explosions and avalanches all mix together.

Massive symbols cover several spots at once, so a single premium block can connect across lots of ways. It's the busiest of the three Crystal Quest games, with the same uncapped multiplier. High volatility, 15,000x cap, 96.16% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
